subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Should Telegram expose a first-class best-effort forum topic name catalog/resolver to agents, and should that surface be prompt metadata, a message action, or a channel metadata endpoint?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow broken-code repair: Telegram does not expose an authoritative bot topic list in the Bot API, and OpenClaw must choose the user-visible API, ambiguity behavior, cache freshness rules, and privacy boundary before implementation.

options.title: Add a scoped topic catalog action
options.body: Expose a Telegram-owned message action or channel metadata endpoint that lists observed topic_id/title pairs for the current chat and fails clearly on stale or ambiguous names.

options.title: Inject observed topics into context
options.body: Add a bounded forum_topics map to session context, accepting prompt-size and metadata-exposure tradeoffs for easier natural-language routing.

options.title: Keep numeric-topic routing only
options.body: Document that agents must use numeric topic ids or operator-maintained mappings until Telegram provides an authoritative bot-side topic lookup.

recommendation.title: Add a scoped topic catalog action
recommendation.body: Expose a Telegram-owned message action or channel metadata endpoint that lists observed topic_id/title pairs for the current chat and fails clearly on stale or ambiguous names.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice should route to someone familiar with the topic-name cache and Telegram plugin boundary introduced by the merged topic-name work.
